name: Online Co-op
author: sotn-online-coop
description: Up to three players, each in their own game, one castle. Host or join from the Netplay menu (Triangle on the title screen). Play as Alucard, PSP Alucard, Richter, the Saturn's long-coat Richter, PSP Maria or Saturn Maria (built from your own discs), picked on the Saturn character select. Don't enable together with Local Co-op.
